verdict.rationale: Ollama documents an OpenAI-compatible interface for connecting OpenAI clients (docs-12), alongside its REST API (gh-4) and local base URLs (docs-9). Community users describe running a local server and hot-swapping models without restarting it (comm-4). The docs say only a subset of the OpenAI API is supported, which limits the compatibility claim. Missing for 10: full OpenAI API coverage rather than a subset, detail on which endpoints are supported, independent hands-on corroboration of OpenAI-client compatibility specifically.
